A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Earth2Ocean work. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–M support comparison despite changes in formatting and placement.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation experiments on six datasets, component and hyperparameter ablations, efficiency measurements, and dataset analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary MLLM experiments.

M1.justification: The GMG, CSA, embedding fusion, and mask-classification procedures are retained. Equation (6)'s correction matches the interpolation already described in v1 and does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both evaluate DUT-USEG, MAS3K, SUIM, USIS10K, USIS16K, and AquaOV255. The classification comparisons, category groupings, and underwater scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding segmentation comparisons retain ClearCLIP, SCLIP, ProxyCLIP, Trident, and CorrCLIP. The VLM classification comparators and GPT-4o/Qwen variants are unchanged; newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: The OpenCLIP backbone configurations, training-free evaluation, metrics, default hyperparameters, and experimental settings in Section 6.1 and Appendix J remain unchanged. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The component, hyperparameter, geometric-layer, and MLLM analyses are retained, as are the grouped-category, long-tail, and qualitative segmentation analyses. Relocated appendix figures contain the same examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: All ten tables retain their numerical entries. For example, Table 1 reports the same Earth2Ocean average mIoU values of 34.32, 44.00, and 49.67 for the three backbones. The plotted findings and qualitative examples are also retained.

T1.justification: Equation (6) changes Vcorr = A·V to Vcorr = A·V′, correcting the formula to reference the interpolated features already specified in the surrounding text. Other mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the principal dataset, benchmark, training-free transfer, and performance claims. The contributions attributed to GMG and CSA remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 6.4's discussion is shortened, but its interpretation of MLLM capability versus model size remains in Appendix L. The mechanism explanations and limitation concerning extremely rare or visually ambiguous species are retained.

D1.justification: The abstract now explicitly directs readers to both code and dataset, whereas v1 advertises code only. The repository destination is unchanged, and the implementation, hardware, prompts, and reproduction details are retained. The PDFs do not establish an actual change in hosted resources.

R1.justification: v2 adds seven references, including SpatialQA, Adaptive Text Dreamer, and clustering studies, through short citation insertions. Section 2 also removes its closing claim of the first systematic investigation of training-free underwater OVS. The broader research positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Localized edits shorten Sections 5.3.2, 6.4, and 6.5 and several captions. Affiliations, contact information, and acknowledgments are revised, while most prose and the main section and appendix sequence are retained.

P2.justification: The document changes from A4 to Letter geometry, with resized and repositioned floats. Figure 5 changes columns, Figures 12–14 appear earlier, and Tables 7–10 move to the final appendix pages. The visual designs and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The empirical evidence is unchanged, and the equation correction and clearer access wording offer small benefits. However, v2 introduces a citation mismatch: Section 2 cites new reference [10] for the UDD dataset, while its bibliography identifies a hyperspectral super-resolution paper. References [57–59] also support a CLIP spatial-cue claim without explaining their connection. These additions slightly weaken the precision of the literature discussion.
